name: Congo, Dem. Rep.
headline: Congo, Dem. Rep.: +5.7% growth in 2025, 7.4% inflation, debt 20% of GDP
sections: Congo, Dem. Rep. is a $92.9 billion economy (2025), the world's 83rd-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +5.7% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $1,920 at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 7.9% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 7.4% in 2025, above typical targets, down from 9.3% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 4.4% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 7.8% (2025).
Gross government debt is 20% of GDP (2025), a low level that has risen from 13% in 2020. The general government balance is −2.4% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is −3.7% of GDP (2025). Trade equals 87% of GDP (2025), a fairly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 2.1% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 33% of GDP by 2031, still rising from today's level. Life expectancy is 62.1 years (2024). Population: 106.6 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
